Does IREN's fee set the new benchmark?

caption:
The most expensive bit of fabric in American sport is about 6cm wide.

NBA clubs have sold one small jersey patch each since 2017-18. This off-season the money moved: Chase, Uline, Paze and Bloom Energy all landed patches, and Sportico reported Australian-founded IREN's new Warriors deal at more than US$50m a year. That's up from the US$60m over three years Rakuten paid in 2017. The NBA sold scarcity, and it's paying off.
